situation_summary: Three tracks in the picture. One hostile (FT-001) inbound toward the asset at priority 1; one unknown (FT-002) at range; one friendly interceptor (FT-003). The hostile and friendly cross around t=67-81 but remain separately tracked.

priority_explanations.rationale: Hostile IFF from C2 plus an independent RF hostile-threat call, closing on the defended asset. Ranked priority 1 under conservative hostile precedence.
priority_explanations.uncertainty_note: Fused horizontal sigma ~28.6 m from four contributing sources; confidence is a heuristic, not a calibrated probability.

priority_explanations.rationale: Friendly IFF; crosses the hostile track but is kept separate by kinematic and class-aware association.
priority_explanations.uncertainty_note: At the crossing, ambiguous weak reports are withheld rather than forced into either track.

missing_information: No absolute-position ground truth for live sensors; confidence is heuristic.
Range-rate from the long-range radar is not yet used in association.
evidence_boundary: Reasoning is over the PROVEN (SCENARIO) fused picture from the deterministic 0-90 s scenario. It is not a field-operational assessment.
